seo.metaTitle: UUID generator — 100% Private In-Browser Utility | PrivacyFold
seo.metaDescription: Make random unique IDs in bulk, using your browser's secure random source. Runs 100% locally in your browser via /wasm/dev/uuid-gen-v1.wasm with zero file uploads.
seo.aeoSummary: UUID generator processes files and text entirely inside your browser tab using /wasm/dev/uuid-gen-v1.wasm (Tier D). Zero bytes are uploaded to any server.

faqs.q: Does UUID generator upload my files or text to a server?
faqs.a: No. UUID generator executes 100% inside your browser's local memory using /wasm/dev/uuid-gen-v1.wasm. No data leaves your device.

faqs.q: Can AI agents or CLI scripts automate UUID generator?
faqs.a: Yes. Use Lane A schema /schemas/uuid_gen.json or open /tools/uuid-gen?mode=agent#payload with input[data-pf='input'] and window.__PRIVACYFOLD_RESULT__.
